q: Is diesel for our factory staff bus Scope 1 or Scope 3?
title: Staff bus: Scope 1 or Scope 3
short: If the company owns or leases and runs the bus, its diesel is Scope 1. If a contractor runs the service and you pay per trip or per month, it is Scope 3 category 7, employee commuting. The invoice tells you which: fuel bills or a transport service bill.
audience: Factories running buses or vans for shift workers

ul: Own bus: fuel invoices or fuel card statements.
Hired service: kilometres per trip and vehicle type, or the contractor's fuel figure.

p: Daily route kilometres × working days ÷ the bus's km per litre × 2.68 kg CO2 per litre of diesel.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel invoices into a dated, fingerprinted record, so each figure shows the quantity, factor and document it came from.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
